navigateApp.name: Navigate the App
navigateApp.description: Learn the basics of navigating CS2Inspect

sidebar.title: Navigation
sidebar.description: This is your main navigation. Browse through weapons, melee items, and extras like agents, pins, and music kits.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Access settings here to change your language, start tutorials, or log out of your account.

loadout.title: Loadout Selector
loadout.description: Switch between your loadouts here. Each loadout stores a complete set of weapon skins, stickers, and customizations.

weapons.title: Weapon Cards
weapons.description: These cards represent your weapons. Click any card to open the skin customization modal where you can select skins, adjust wear, and add stickers.

teamTabs.title: Team Tabs
teamTabs.description: Some weapons can be used by both teams (CT and T). When that's the case, you'll see two tabs here — one for each team. Each team has its own separate skin configuration.

ready.title: You're Ready!
ready.description: You now know the basics of navigating CS2Inspect. Explore the app and customize your loadout!

customizeWeapon.name: Customize a Weapon
customizeWeapon.description: Learn all features of the weapon customization modal

grid.title: Weapon Grid
grid.description: These are the weapon cards for your current loadout. Each card shows the weapon with its currently applied skin.

click.title: Open Customization
click.description: Click on a weapon card to open the skin customization modal. You can also use the Next button to continue.

search.title: Search Skins
search.description: Use the search bar to quickly find skins by name. Start typing to filter the skin list.

sortFilter.title: Sort & Filter
sortFilter.description: Sort skins by name, rarity, or other criteria. Use the rarity filter buttons to show only skins of a specific quality.

skins.title: Skin Gallery
skins.description: Browse available skins here. Click on a skin to select it. The selected skin will be highlighted with a yellow ring.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: If there are more skins than fit on one page, use the pagination buttons to browse through additional pages.

wear.title: Wear Slider
wear.description: Adjust the wear (float value) of your skin. Lower values mean less wear and a cleaner appearance. The slider range depends on the skin's minimum and maximum float. The weapon preview image updates automatically as you change the value.

paintIndex.title: Paint Index Override
paintIndex.description: Enable this toggle to manually set the paint index value. This is an advanced feature that lets you specify an exact skin ID instead of selecting from the gallery.

activeSwitch.title: Active Toggle
activeSwitch.description: Toggle the weapon active or inactive. Inactive weapons won't be included when generating your loadout. Useful for keeping a skin configured without using it.

stickers.title: Sticker Slots
stickers.description: Your weapon has 5 sticker slots. Click any slot to browse and apply stickers. You can drag stickers between slots to reposition them. Hover over a sticker to see the remove button.

keychain.title: Keychain
keychain.description: Attach a keychain charm to your weapon. Click the slot to browse available keychains. Each weapon can have one keychain.

reset.title: Reset Weapon
reset.description: Reset the weapon back to its default state. This removes the skin, stickers, keychain, and all customizations.

history.title: Version History
history.description: View the history of changes made to this weapon. You can restore any previous version with a single click.

import.title: Import Inspect Link
import.description: Import a weapon configuration from a CS2 inspect link. Paste a link to apply its skin, stickers, wear, and other settings to this weapon.

generate.title: Generate Inspect Link
generate.description: Generate a CS2 inspect link for your current weapon configuration. The link can be shared or used to preview the weapon in-game.

autoSave.title: Auto-Save
autoSave.description: Your changes are automatically saved as you make them. The save indicator shows the current status — no need to manually save anything.

inspectLink.name: Inspect Link Tool
inspectLink.description: Learn how to decode and generate inspect links

input.title: Inspect Link Input
input.description: Paste a CS2 inspect link here. These links start with 'steam://rungame/' and contain encoded item data.

decode.title: Decode Button
decode.description: Click this button to decode the inspect link into readable JSON data. The decoded data will appear in the editor below.

editor.title: JSON Editor
editor.description: View and edit the decoded item data here. You can modify values like paintindex, paintwear, stickers, and more.

generate.title: Generate Link
generate.description: After editing the JSON data, click here to generate a new inspect link. The link will be copied to your clipboard automatically.

createLoadout.name: Create a Loadout
createLoadout.description: Learn how to create and manage your loadouts

selector.title: Loadout Selector
selector.description: This dropdown shows all your loadouts. A loadout is a complete set of weapon skins, stickers, and customizations that you can switch between.

create.title: Manage Loadouts
create.description: This button opens the loadout management menu. From here you can create, rename, duplicate, share, import, and delete loadouts.

name.title: Name Your Loadout
name.description: Enter a name for your new loadout. Choose something descriptive like 'Tournament Setup' or 'Favorite Skins'.

done.title: All Set!
done.description: Your new loadout is ready to use. You can now switch between loadouts using the selector and start customizing your weapons.
